# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and household assistant  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P75](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0075), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has brown paws and her hair is plaited into tails tied with bright blue ribbons. When dressing up, she wears a stiffly starched white dress. Before sleeping or styling her hair, she braids it into innumerable plaits.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a literal-minded, faithful, and energetic handmaiden who worries intensely over her mistress's well-being and household duties. Highly conscientious and lively, she flies around briskly when there is work to be done. She possesses a very practical, straightforward view of life, holding little patience for men or romantic idealizations while worrying about hypothetical misfortunes.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)_

- Literal-minded  <sub>[v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053)</sub>

- Blowing a tin horn and producing echoes  <sub>[v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071)</sub>

## Goals

- To care for Miss Lavendar and see her happy  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman came to live with Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge as a young girl, receiving board and care in exchange for her work. Miss Lavendar gave her the name 'Charlotta the Fourth' to avoid confusion with her three older sisters who had previously held the post before moving to Boston. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon Echo Lodge, Charlotta served them biscuits and demonstrated the local echoes. She later confided in Anne about her deep concerns regarding Miss Lavendar's declining health and spirits, including an incident where she accidentally broke a cherished heirloom bowl without receiving any scolding. Upon learning that Stephen Irving was coming to reunite with Miss Lavendar, Charlotta was overjoyed, secretly watching him from the kitchen window. Before Miss Lavendar's wedding, Charlotta worked tirelessly alongside Anne and Diana to prepare the home and food. On the wedding day, she dressed in her finest attire and watched the ceremony proceed smoothly.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P49](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0049), [v2 c28 P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest and last of the Bowman sisters who served Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her older sisters Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina preceded her in service  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

> In this world you’ve just got to hope for the best and prepare for the worst and take whatever God sends.  <sub>[v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)</sub>

> Courting’s all right in its place, Miss Shirley, ma’am, but if you try to mix it up with cooking and scouring everything’s spoiled.  <sub>[v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>

> But I’d rather look like you than be pretty  <sub>[v2 c27 P40](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0040)</sub>
